forced.reason: Native Android build (Kotlin Views overlay + Jetpack Compose setup). The phase machine's scaffold (layout.css), plates-in-page check and hero comp-diff over a browser capture apply to HTML/CSS only. The spec was measured (regions, palette, caption-sub type metrics; no plates: every region is code-drawn); the build was then verified against the comps from Android 15 emulator captures in .impeccable/review/ (hero-repro.png is the comp-1 scene), and judged by the finish reviewer.
